columns.name: ad_group_criterion_criterion_id
columns.comment: The ID of the criterion. This field is ignored for mutates.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_bidding_category_id
columns.comment: ID of the product bidding category. This ID is equivalent to the google_product_category ID as described in this article: https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324436

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_category_category_id
columns.comment: ID of the product category. This ID is equivalent to the google_product_category ID as described in this article: https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324436

columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_cpc_bid_micros
columns.comment: The CPC (cost-per-click) bid.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_display_name
columns.comment: The display name of the criterion. This field is ignored for mutates.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_bidding_category_level
columns.comment: Level of the product bidding category.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_brand_value
columns.comment: String value of the product brand.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_category_level
columns.comment: Level of the product category.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_channel_channel
columns.comment: Value of the locality.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_channel_exclusivity_channel_exclusivity
columns.comment: Value of the availability.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_condition_condition
columns.comment: Value of the condition.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_custom_attribute_index
columns.comment: Indicates the index of the custom attribute.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_custom_attribute_value
columns.comment: String value of the product custom attribute.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_item_id_value
columns.comment: Value of the id.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_type_level
columns.comment: Level of the type.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_listing_group_case_value_product_type_value
columns.comment: Value of the type.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_status
columns.comment: The status of the criterion.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpc
columns.comment: The total cost of all clicks divided by the total number of clicks received.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpm
columns.comment: Average cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM).

columns.name: metrics_clicks
columns.comment: The number of clicks.

columns.name: metrics_cost_micros
columns.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period.

columns.name: metrics_ctr
columns.comment: The number of clicks your ad receives (Clicks) divided by the number of times your ad is shown (Impressions).

columns.name: metrics_impressions
columns.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

columns.name: product_group_view_resource_name
columns.comment: The resource name of the product group view. Product group view resource names have the form: customers/{customer_id}/productGroupViews/{ad_group_id}~{criterion_id}

columns.name: segments_date
columns.comment: Date to which metrics apply. yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g., 2018-04-17.

columns.name: segments_day_of_week
columns.comment: Day of the week, e.g., MONDAY.

columns.name: segments_month
columns.comment: Month as represented by the date of the first day of a month. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_quarter
columns.comment: Quarter as represented by the date of the first day of a quarter. Uses the calendar year for quarters, e.g., the second quarter of 2018 starts on 2018-04-01. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_week
columns.comment: Week as defined as Monday through Sunday, and represented by the date of Monday. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_year
columns.comment: Year, formatted as yyyy.
